name: Chat history, confirm deletion
summary: The counted path's gate. The title carries the number and the body is plural, with the same note that saved memories outlive the chats.

looseEnds.title: The count in the title is drawn, not derived
looseEnds.detail: 'Delete 3 chats?' is a text node. Nothing states the singular, so one selected chat would read '1 chats?' unless a developer decides otherwise — and the all-selected path uses different wording again.
looseEnds.ask: Give the title one inflected string covering one, several and all.

looseEnds.title: The dialog layer is called 'Delete memory'
looseEnds.detail: The alert is a layer named 'Delete memory', copied from the Memory section. The copy inside is about chats.
